name: 01-scattered
text: There's always another update. Another spreadsheet. Another seller to get back to.

name: 02-together
text: Repeat A I brings your property work together, so the next conversation starts with the right context.

name: 03-sellers
text: Connect your spreadsheets. Keep your sellers, their properties, and your follow-ups in one place.

name: 04-market
text: Follow the buildings you cover. Spot asking-price changes, and see what's moved since you last checked.

name: 05-assistant
text: Need an answer? Type a question, or talk to Repeat A I. Get help with your market, your sellers, and your next step.

name: 06-follow-up
text: Make every follow-up feel personal. Start with your own wording, add the property context, and preview it for WhatsApp.

name: 07-schedule
text: Plan the week by building. Choose what to follow up, and when.

name: 08-integrations
text: Bring your tools along. Google Sheets and Excel. Gmail and Outlook. Calendars. Even Claude and Chat G P T, through an M C P connection.

name: 09-platforms
text: And keep going across web, Windows, and mobile. At your desk, between viewings, wherever the day takes you.

name: 10-close
text: Less admin. More useful conversations. Repeat A I.
